chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Muʿallā ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Jumhūr, from Ismāʿīl ibn Sahl, from Al-Qāsim ibn ʿUrwah, from Abū Al-Safātij, from Zurārah, from Abū Jaʿfar (عليه السلام) regarding His, the Exalted, saying:
But when they see it near, the faces of those who disbelieved will be distressed, and it will be said: This is what you used to claim.

He said: This was revealed concerning Amīr al-Muʾminīn and his companions, and those who did what they did. They will see Amīr al-Muʾminīn (عليه السلام) in the most enviable stations for them, so their faces will be darkened, and it will be said to them: This is what you used to claim, the one whose name you falsely appropriated.

key_terms.أَغْبَطِ الْأَمَاكِنِ: the most enviable stations or places of highest blessed status
key_terms.أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the title of Imam ʿAlī (عليه السلام), central here as the subject of the verse’s interpretation
key_terms.اسْمَهُ: his name or title, referring to the usurped designation
key_terms.انْتَحَلْتُمِ: you falsely appropriated or claimed for yourselves
key_terms.تَدَّعُونَ: you used to claim or call for, implying prior false assertion
key_terms.زُلْفَةً: near at hand; brought close so that the reality is directly witnessed
key_terms.سِيئَتْ: became distressed or darkened with grief and displeasure

ai.seo_question: How is Qur'an 67:27 interpreted in Shia hadith regarding Amīr al-Muʾminīn (عليه السلام)?
ai.summary: This hadith presents the verse as referring to the manifestation of the rank of Amīr al-Muʾminīn (عليه السلام) before those who opposed him. When they witness his exalted station, their faces are struck with distress and disgrace, and they are confronted with the false claims they used to make. The report thus links the verse to wilayah, ultimate reckoning, and the exposure of false pretensions.

en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Jamhour, from Ismail Bin Sahl, from Al Qasim Bin Urwa, from Abu Al Saffatij, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu ja’far<sup>asws</sup> regarding the Words of the Exalted
[67:27] But when they shall see it nigh, the faces of those who disbelieve shall be sorry, and it shall be said; This is that which you used to be called by.

Heasws said: ‘This was Revealed regarding Amir Al-Momineenasws and hisasws contemporaries, those who did what they did. They will be seeing Amir Al-Momineenasws in places which would be enviable to them, despair in their faces, and it shall be said; This is that which you used to be called by, those who impersonated by hisasws name (i.e., they were named as Amir Al-Momineen)’.
en.sarwar: 68. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Salma ibn al-Khattab from Ali ibn Hassa’n from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn Kathir from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) about the words of Allah, the Most High. “and by the witness (Muhammad) and that which is witnessed (the Day of Judgment),” [85:3]
The Imam (a.s.) said, “They are The Holy Prophet (s.a) and Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.).”
